name: uberdev
description: GitHub workflow commands: /solve spawns autonomous agents in cmux/Ghostty/iTerm to solve issues with tier-aware triage; /issue creates well-investigated, deduped, label-validated issues. Full Superpowers skill suite ported and rebranded for UberDev: brainstorm (with browser-based visual companion), write-plan, execute-plan, subagent-driven-dev (wave-based parallel execution), finish-branch, systematic-debugging, test-driven-development, using-git-worktrees, dispatching-parallel-agents, verification-before-completion, requesting/receiving-code-review, writing-skills, using-uberdev. Bundles PR review agents (code-reviewer, code-simplifier, comment-analyzer, plan-reviewer, pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter, type-design-analyzer) and a SessionStart hook that injects the using-uberdev primer. v0.4.0 spreads parallel-fanout across the plugin: /review-pr now dispatches all review agents concurrently by default (sequential is opt-in), /issue runs Phase 2/3/4 investigation as three parallel agents, verification-before-completion documents parallel verification dispatch, systematic-debugging adds competing-hypothesis fanout, brainstorm gains optional parallel design-direction exploration, write-plan gains opt-in alternative-plan generation, receiving-code-review adds multi-reviewer parallel triage. Continues v0.3.1's /simplify orchestrator alignment.
